search_text: published ZDI-05-001 ZDI-CAN-001 VERITAS NetBackup Remote Code Execution 2005-10-12 CVE-2005-2715 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2005-2715 ['Symantec'] ['Veritas NetBackup'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable NetBackup installations. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. This specific flaw exists within the bpjava-msvc daemon due to incorrect handling of format string data passed through the 'COMMAND_LOGON_TO_MSERVER' command. The vulnerable daemon listens on TCP port 13722 and affects both NetBackup clients and servers. title: VERITAS NetBackup Remote Code Execution
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable NetBackup installations. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. This specific flaw exists within the bpjava-msvc daemon due to incorrect handling of format string data passed through the 'COMMAND_LOGON_TO_MSERVER' command. The vulnerable daemon listens on TCP port 13722 and affects both NetBackup clients and servers.
